title: InitializableHarness — Nested Initializer Revert-DoS Patterns Exposed
severity: Medium (informational for FV, hazard if copied)
impact: `nested_init_init()` etc. demonstrate that nested initializer calls revert — correct behavior, but the harness's public `disable()` lets anyone brick initialization of a shared instance. In a proxy deployment pattern copied from this file, front-running `initialize()`/`_disableInitializers()` is the classic uninitialized-proxy takeover.
